original_objective: Clean the raw 2024 smart-meter export and analyse electricity consumption: total and per-building-type usage, the quarterly trend, the change between the first and second half of the year, tariff and meter usage, commercial load on hot days and the distribution of consumption and temperature, then report the verified findings to business stakeholders.

cleaning.cleaning_logic: The cleaning script applies all 9 requirements in order: (R1) strips whitespace and standardizes missing values (empty, NA, N/A, null, None, -); (R2) removes duplicate reading_id records keeping the first occurrence; (R3) parses dates in 5 formats and outputs as YYYY-MM-DD; (R4) uppercases meter_id; (R5) maps building_type variants to Residential/Commercial/Industrial; (R6) maps tariff variants to peak/off-peak; (R7) converts energy to kWh (handling MWh and kWh units, removing commas) and validates range 0-100000; (R8) converts temperature to Celsius (handling F and C units) and sets out-of-range values to missing while keeping the row; (R9) outputs the 7 required columns sorted by reading_id.
